description: Imports a DXF into the open CIVIL NX model with the Advanced DXF Importer plugin's engine: the same parse, layer mapping, clean-up and write as the plugin. Nodes and elements get new ids above the model's (existing rows are never overwritten); each layer's structure group is created or added to; blank properties become the plugin's DXF default material (C40/50), section (SB 500x300) and thickness (250), created or reused by name. Previews by default (writes nothing): the plan with id ranges, groups, default properties and any unit switch. To write, call again with the same inputs, apply: true and confirmPlanHash; the model is read again and the write refused if the plan changed. The write creates a master group DXF_<file> #<token> first, then the unit change, properties, nodes, elements and groups, then reads everything back to verify. The import journal is recorded so dxf_import_undo can remove exactly what it created, even after a partial failure. Inputs as for dxf_inspect, plus mergeExisting.

apply.description: Write to CIVIL NX. Only after the user approved the preview.

arcChord.description: Instead of arcSegments: largest chord deviation, mm.

confirmPlanHash.description: planHash from the approved preview; the write is refused if the plan differs.

drawingUnits.description: The drawing's units when it does not record them ($INSUNITS; R12 files never do), or to override them.

dxfBase64.description: The DXF file's bytes, base64, up to 4 MB decoded.

dxfText.description: The DXF file's text (ASCII DXF), up to 4 MB. Use dxfBase64 for a binary DXF or an R12 file with non-ASCII layer names (the bytes then keep their code page).

fileName.description: Name of the drawing (default: from the URL or path, else drawing.dxf). It names the import's master group DXF_<name> #<token>.

filePath.description: Local server only: a path to the DXF on this machine, up to 50 MB.

ignoreAnnotationLayers.description: Untick layers that are empty or mostly annotation (TEXT, DIMENSION, HATCH…), as the plugin's bulk action does.

mapping.description: Layer mapping in the plugin's preset format (the file Save mapping writes). rules apply in order, first match wins, * and ? wildcards, case-insensitive; layers are exact names and override the rules. Per class (linear = lines/polylines/arcs/splines, face = 3DFACE/polyface/mesh, point): as BEAM|TRUSS|IGNORE (linear), PLATE|IGNORE (face), NODE|IGNORE (point); material, section (linear) or thickness (face) as an id, a name or {id,name} (omitted = the DXF default property, created on import); beta (deg); group ('{layer}' = the layer name); split (split at intersections); plate THICK|THIN; include false drops a layer. Example: {rules:[{layer:'*GIRDER*', class:'linear', as:'BEAM', material:'C40/50', section:'G1', group:'Girders'}, {layer:'DIM*', include:false}], layers:{SLAB:{face:{as:'PLATE', thickness:'Slab 250'}}}}

matchModelUnits.description: As in the plugin: switch the CIVIL NX model's length unit to the drawing's (mm/cm/m/in/ft) before writing. DESTRUCTIVE when it changes the unit — the preview says so; undo switches it back. false = keep the model's unit and convert the coordinates.

mergeExisting.description: Reuse existing model nodes within the merge tolerance instead of creating new ones there (reused nodes join no group).

origin.description: Move the drawing: {mode:'none'} (default), {mode:'min'} (drawing minimum to 0,0,0), or {mode:'user', x, y, z} (metres, subtracted). Use it for OS-grid / site coordinates.

plane.description: Flat drawings only: XY → plan (global XY), XZ → elevation, YZ → side elevation.

planeOffset.description: Flat drawings only: metres added along the axis the drawing's normal maps to.

url.description: An https address the DXF is downloaded from, up to 25 MB (public hosts only on the website).

name: dxf_import
title: Advanced DXF Importer — import into CIVIL NX
